info.title: Stride API
info.description: Task-management API for AI agents. Human-readable reference: docs/api/README.md. Every authenticated operation requires a board-scoped Bearer token.

get.description: Served without authentication. Responses carry `cache-control: public, max-age=3600`.

200.description: The OpenAPI 3.1 description of the Stride API.

get.summary: List tasks on the token's board
get.description: Without any of limit, cursor, status, type, priority, assigned_to_id, parent or updated_since the legacy unpaginated list is returned. Supplying any of them switches to cursor pagination ordered by id. Archived tasks are never returned. For incremental sync with updated_since, use the full view (slim rows carry no updated_at), derive the bound from server-stamped updated_at values (UTC, no offset) minus an overlap longer than one paging pass, upsert rows by id, and run a periodic full pass because archived or deleted tasks never appear in an updated_since pass (board moves and reorders do: they update updated_at on the moved task and on every neighbour whose position shifts); see docs/api/get_tasks.md#incremental-sync.

200.description: Tasks; `meta` is present only in paginated mode.

post.summary: Create a task, or a goal with nested child tasks
post.description: `type` must be exactly `work`, `defect` or `goal` (lowercase, no surrounding whitespace); an omitted `type` key defaults to `work`. Any other value, including `null`, an empty or whitespace-only string, a number, a case variant such as `Work`, or a mistaken name such as `bug` or `task`, is rejected with a 422 whose `errors.type` names the problem, and nothing is persisted. When `tasks` is non-empty the request always creates a goal and the top-level `type` is ignored, but every child's `type` is validated the same way: one invalid child type rejects the whole request, goal included. A child's `type` must be `work` or `defect`: a goal cannot contain another goal, so a child of type `goal` is rejected with a 422 before any identifier is assigned, and nothing is persisted. Tasks nest one level only, so a child with a non-empty `tasks` list of its own is rejected the same way, with `errors.tasks`. A `work` or `defect` task whose target column is already at its WIP limit is rejected with a 422 naming the WIP limit, and nothing is persisted; a column with a WIP limit of `0` is unlimited, and only non-archived `work` and `defect` tasks count toward a limit. Goals are exempt: a `goal`, including one created with nested child tasks, is never counted or blocked, and its children are not checked against the limit when they are created, though they count toward it once they exist. A `task.column_id` that is not an integer returns 400. A column that does not exist or is on another board returns 404, and so does a whole-number `column_id` outside the signed 64-bit range, whether sent as a JSON number or a string.

201.description: Created task, or created goal with its children.

422.description: Validation failed. Nothing is persisted. An unrecognised `type` reports `errors.type: ["is invalid"]`; a `null`, empty or whitespace-only type reports `can't be blank`. A nested child task of type `goal` reports `errors.type` saying a goal cannot contain another goal. A nested child with its own non-empty `tasks` reports `errors.tasks`. A `work` or `defect` task targeting a column at its WIP limit reports `error` naming the WIP limit, with `documentation` and `common_causes`.

nestedGoal.summary: A nested child task of type goal

type: must be 'work' or 'defect' for a task inside a goal; a goal cannot contain another goal

wipLimitReached.summary: Target column is at its WIP limit

value.error: WIP limit reached for this column — work and defect tasks cannot be added until a slot frees up
common_causes: The target column (Backlog by default) already holds as many work and defect tasks as its WIP limit allows
WIP limits count only non-archived work and defect tasks; goals are never counted or blocked
Wait for a task to leave the column, archive one, or ask a board owner to raise the column's WIP limit (0 means unlimited)

404.description: No task available matching your capabilities.

identifier.description: Task to claim. Omit to claim the next available task.

200.description: Claimed task plus before_doing hook metadata.

post.summary: Create several goals with nested tasks
post.description: Goals are created one at a time and processing stops at the first goal that fails; goals before it stay created. Each goal is created with its children in one transaction. A child task `type` must be exactly `work` or `defect`: a goal cannot contain another goal, so a child of type `goal` is rejected the same way, before any identifier is assigned. A child with a non-empty `tasks` list of its own is rejected too, with `details.tasks`. An invalid child type returns 422 with the failing goal's `index` (the child's position is not reported) and `details.type`, and neither that goal nor any of its children is persisted. A goal's own `type` is ignored: every top-level entry is created as a goal. Every goal and child gets its own identifier, unique on the board across the whole batch. Batch creation does not check column WIP limits: goals are exempt and child tasks are not checked when they are created, so a full target column does not reject a batch. Once created, child tasks count toward the column's limit like any other work or defect task.

goals.description: The root key must be `goals`, not `tasks`.

422.description: Validation failed for the goal at `index`, or the root key was not `goals`. Goals before `index` were created; the failing goal and its children were not.

bearerAuth.description: Board-scoped Stride API token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

TaskId.name: id
TaskId.description: Numeric task id or task identifier (for example W21). A numeric id outside the signed 64-bit range (below -9223372036854775808 or above 9223372036854775807) returns 404 with the same body as an id that names no task.

ResponseView.name: response_view
ResponseView.description: `slim` selects the compact view. Any other value, or absence, returns the full view.

Fields.name: fields
Fields.description: Comma-separated projection of allow-listed task fields. Mutually exclusive with response_view (422).

SkillsVersion.name: skills_version
SkillsVersion.description: The caller's skills version; an older value adds skills_update_required to the response.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Page size, 1-200. Supplying it switches to paginated mode; in paginated mode the page size is 50 when limit is omitted.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor from meta.next_cursor of the previous page.

AssignedToId.name: assigned_to_id
AssignedToId.description: Filter by assignee user id (paginated mode).

Parent.name: parent
Parent.description: Filter to the children of a goal, by goal identifier (paginated mode). At most 255 bytes.

UpdatedSince.name: updated_since
UpdatedSince.description: Only tasks updated at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp (paginated mode); inclusive, offsets converted to UTC, no offset read as UTC, fractional seconds floored to the whole second. Take the value from server time (server-stamped updated_at), never the client clock, minus an overlap, and expect duplicates.

ColumnId.name: column_id
ColumnId.description: Restrict to one column on the token's board. Works in both legacy and paginated mode. A column that does not exist or is on another board returns 404, and so does a whole number outside the signed 64-bit range. A value that is not an integer returns 400.

BadRequest.description: Malformed query parameter, or a request-body column_id that is not an integer.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid Authorization header, or invalid API token.

Forbidden.description: The token lacks access to this task, column or action.

NotFound.description: Task not found on this board. Also returned for a numeric task id or column_id outside the signed 64-bit range, with the same body. A task or column on another board gets the same response.

NotAcceptable.description: The Accept header (or a `_format` parameter) asks for a format the API does not serve. Every /api route serves only JSON: send `Accept: application/json`, `*/*`, `application/vnd.oai.openapi+json`, or no Accept header. Returned before authentication runs, so it says nothing about the token.

Conflict.description: The task is not claimable (blocked, already claimed, or capability mismatch).

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limited after repeated authentication failures.

inserted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp without a UTC offset (naive datetime).

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp without a UTC offset (naive datetime).

TaskSummary.description: Compact task summary served by response_view=slim, /dependencies, /dependents and goal creation.

TaskAck.description: Acknowledgement view returned by response_view=slim on /complete and /changed_files.

TaskProjection.description: Projection returned by GET /api/tasks/{id}?fields=... — id and identifier plus exactly the requested allow-listed fields. Because it is open-ended, a full or slim body also satisfies this branch; the `fields` query parameter is what selects it.

GoalSummary.description: Goal render used by goal creation responses.

inserted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp without a UTC offset (naive datetime).

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp without a UTC offset (naive datetime).

output.description: Combined stdout/stderr of the hook run.

Hook.description: Hook metadata. The hook itself runs on the agent's machine, never on the server.

SkillsUpdateRequired.description: Present only when the caller reported a skills_version strictly older than the server's.

data.description: Full task, or TaskAck when response_view=slim.

PageMeta.description: Present only in paginated mode (any of limit, cursor, status, type, priority, assigned_to_id, parent, updated_since supplied).

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

data.description: Full tasks, or TaskSummary rows when response_view=slim.

children.description: Full children, or TaskSummary rows when response_view=slim. The root task is always full.

child_tasks.description: The goal's children. A goal contains only work and defect tasks, never another goal, so a child's `type` is never `goal`.

Error.description: Error body for most non-changeset failures: `error` is present, and documentation keys (documentation, getting_started, related_docs, common_causes, ...) are added on most 4xx responses. Changeset failures return ValidationError instead.

documentation.description: A documentation URL, a list of URLs when several fields fail, or an object of documentation links.

ValidationError.description: Changeset validation failure. `errors` maps each field to its messages; an embedded list field (key_files, verification_steps, behaviour_test_matrix) maps to one object per entry in the resulting list, keyed by that entry's own fields (an empty object for a valid entry).

documentation.description: A documentation URL, a list of URLs when several fields fail, or an object of documentation links.

Onboarding.description: Agent onboarding payload. Only a few stable keys are listed; see docs/api/get_agent_onboarding.md for the full structure.

task.description: Task fields. For a goal, set type to goal and nest child tasks under `tasks`; each child must be work or defect, because goals cannot be nested. On update, changing a goal's child to type goal is rejected with 422. See docs/api/post_tasks.md.

agent_name.description: Agent display name for created_by_agent attribution.
